decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won the gold medal of the Deutsches Brotinstitut again in 2023 and in 2024, so much of the uncertainty about its value has resolved favorably and the firm should commit to it rather than abandon it.
The dark malt rye bread survived the 2024 pruning that removed its sibling breads A, C and F, which suggests its results justify keeping this cheap option open on existing production lines.
The marzipan stollen still has its own page in 2024, fits the firm's strong seasonal stollen franchise, and costs little to keep as a complement to the award-winning raisin stollen, so it stays.
